==Biography==
Abbedagge was born in Baden-Baden, Germany.<ref>[https://twitter.com/lcsofficial/status/1556025027417346048?lang=en LCS' Tweet] ''twitter.com''</ref>

== Trivia ==
* His ID '''Abbedagge''' comes from a unit's sound in [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Age_of_Empires Age of Empires].<ref>[https://twitter.com/S04Esports/status/1069300013040316418 FC Schalke 04 Esports' Tweet] ''twitter.com''</ref>
* Nicknamed "Fakerdagge" by fans and casters when playing really well.
** Nicknamed "Abbedoggy" when playing poorly.<ref>[https://twitter.com/jojopyunlol/status/1518296315742101506?lang=en Jojopyun's Tweet] ''twitter.com''</ref>
